title: TreeGraft：基于树形投机解码的自适应多草稿器嫁接框架
summary: TreeGraft提出多草稿器框架，通过强弱草稿器协作构建共享草稿树，强草稿器重打分、重选嫁接位置并恢复路径，非破坏性扩展分支，并利用轻量调度器控制成本。在10个模型对和6个基准上平均提升15.1%，最高达26.6%。
summary_en: TreeGraft proposes a multi-drafter framework for tree-based speculative decoding, where a stronger drafter rescore candidates, reselect grafting positions, and recover paths, with a lightweight scheduler to control cost. It outperforms fixed single-drafter strategies by 15.1% on average across 10 model pairs and 6 benchmarks.
